system.description:
This sleight can only be performed by exsurgents infected by the biological nanovirus and can only affect biomorphs. The exsurgent increases the Infection Rating (p. 171) of their bio-nanobots by +30 for the duration of the sleight. During this time, the pathogen they exude will be more likely to infect victims it is exposed to.

Source: X-Risks, p. 179.
